implementation_evidence.limitation: Synthetic Open API v2 JVM-adapter evidence only; no live WorkBuddy account, credential, protected message, network request, alternate API version, or other device/platform combination is verified.

boundary.authority: Agent Relay owns identity, leases, policy, approvals, persistence, retries, cancellation, and completion.
boundary.transport: HTTPS Open API v2 only; no undocumented gateway is assumed.
boundary.credentials: OAuth tokens are opaque approved-store references.
boundary.network: Live network access is disabled by default; tests use deterministic fixtures.

capabilities.evidence: The adapter maps bounded GET /openapi/v2/localassistant replies and synthetic auth, authorization, online, offline, malformed, oversized, timeout, and cleanup cases.
capabilities.unsupported_outcome: Authentication, authorization, offline, and unavailable outcomes remain explicit and fail closed.

capabilities.evidence: The adapter sends bounded msg_type=text input over standard input and maps message_id, authentication, authorization, rate-limit, failure, and unknown-delivery outcomes.
capabilities.unsupported_outcome: Non-text, permission_response, repeated unknown-delivery, working-directory, model, and provider session options are unsupported.

capabilities.evidence: The adapter maps bounded limit/offset history pages and rejects duplicate IDs, attachments, unknown roles or types, malformed fields, and oversized content.
capabilities.unsupported_outcome: Unbounded, malformed, duplicate, attachment-bearing, or non-text history fails closed.

capabilities.evidence: The API documents messages but no stable external session identifier
capabilities.unsupported_outcome: UNSUPPORTED; do not derive identity from content or timestamps.

capabilities.evidence: The API documents polling, not a streaming endpoint or ordered event protocol
permission_response is rejected and no compatible approval handshake is documented
No cancellation endpoint or delivery token is documented
No revisioned changed-file manifest is established
capabilities.unsupported_outcome: UNSUPPORTED; never infer changes from message text.

invariants.rule: Endpoint, content, page size, offset, poll interval, and timeouts are finite and bounded before I/O.
Events contain opaque message references and bounded text; tokens, prompts, routes, and raw payloads are excluded.
Only msg_type=text is forwarded; permission_response and unknown types fail closed.
Pages are at most 100 messages and cursors are size and shape validated.
A timeout after submission is UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and never automatically replayed.
WorkBuddy responses are adapter observations; Agent Relay owns durable state.

deterministic_test_plan.scenario: Validate official URLs, hashes, retrieval date, and /openapi/v2.
Reject duplicate IDs, unknown statuses, and claims without evidence.
Reject non-HTTPS endpoints, oversized content/cursors, invalid limits, and token material.
Accept synthetic text and reject permission_response, unknown types, and malformed IDs.
Replay bounded pages and incremental replies, duplicate IDs, gaps, and malformed fields.
Preserve a post-submit timeout as non-retryable UNKNOWN_OUTCOME.
Assert fixtures contain no secrets, private paths, addresses, or real transcripts.
